purpose: State-scoped coverage inventory for Indiana 2024 result, review, turnout, map, historical, and election-administration context sources. This inventory records source availability and blockers; it does not promote production data and does not allege fraud or misconduct.
authorityPriority: Official Indiana Election Division, Indiana Election Commission/Recount Commission, county election offices, official GIS/Census, and EAC sources first; secondary sources are context only and caveated.

caveats: Archived official ENR category JSON contains county RegionSummary rows, not precinct/subcounty candidate rows.
Certified county map/result totals remain sourced from this official Indiana ENR artifact.
Supports county-level President-versus-U.S. Senate comparison only.
Does not replace the need for official same-grain precinct/subcounty President and U.S. Senate rows.
JurR files preserve county office/contact and reporting-region/referendum structures.
Collected JurR files do not contain President or U.S. Senate candidate result rows and are not advisory flag inputs.

loadedArtifacts.parserNormalizationPath: scripts/normalize-in-turnout.mjs to normalizedTurnoutCsv via etl/state-configs/in.json turnout.format=normalizedTurnoutCsv
caveats: County turnout denominator, not precinct turnout denominator.
Voters Voting is election-level turnout, not presidential contest votes.
Retained as national fallback/benchmark context after state-native turnout was loaded.
Configured Indiana turnout now uses the official Indiana Election Division county turnout report.

loadedArtifacts.sourceAuthority: MIT Election Data and Science Lab with official Indiana ENR and supplemental OpenElections county sources
caveats: Supplemental advisory review rows only; certified totals remain official Indiana ENR county rows.
MIT warns Indiana Senate/Governor totals are overreported in some counties and precinct labels are not always unique identifiers.
County geometry supports current county result map joins.
Precinct boundary geometry is not included.
Secondary jurisdiction-level equipment context only.
Does not replace official Indiana result, turnout, audit, recount, CVR, incident, correction, or custody records.

loadedArtifacts.sourceAuthority: Indiana Secretary of State Election Division / VSTOP
caveats: Official VSTOP audit summary context only; rows cover seven voluntarily audited counties and selected contests.
These rows do not replace certified ENR totals and are not proof of fraud or misconduct.
Detailed audit-unit workpapers, CVR exports, recount records, incident logs, and correction records remain separate request items.
Historical rows are contextual county baselines, not 2024 certified data.
The 2012 official Indiana Voters endpoint table reconciles county rows to its statewide candidate rows; 2016 and 2020 use official ENR archive JSON category files.
